scope: Canonical temporary synthetic root only. No Production connection, launch, replacement, permit, backup or restore.
entrypoint: run_integrated(root: &str, callback: &(dyn Fn(&str, serde_json::Value) -> Result<(), Failure> + Send + Sync)) -> Result<serde_json::Value, Failure>

other_entrypoints.hash_entrypoint: Call before constructing Tauri: Option<Result<(), Failure>>; hash role never creates a webview or SQLite connection.
other_entrypoints.diagnostic_integrated: Read durable files only; root: &str -> Result<Value, Failure>. Unresolved/corrupt/pending/mismatched records block startup. V4_VERIFIED still requires separate handoff authority.
other_entrypoints.recover_integrated: root: &str, authorization_path: &str, callback -> Result<Value, Failure>. Authorization path must be root/recovery-authorization.json. New read-only DB verification; never reruns M4 or restores anything.

managed_contract_required_fields.objects: array of {role,path,kind,dev,inode,size,links,mode,sha256}; kind file|directory; directory sha256 null; file hash lowercase SHA256; paths cover entire root/managed tree including its root
managed_contract_required_fields.bundles: array of {role,path,executable,info_plist,manifest,bundle_id,enabled}; exactly one each installed/candidate/staging/archive; any discovered nested runtime has role nested
managed_contract_required_fields.known_nested: unique array of exact absolute nested bundle paths
managed_contract_required_fields.launch_routes: array of {path,enabled}; all bundle executables and known helper/bare image routes; only installed executable enabled
managed_contract_required_fields.processes: nonempty array of {pid,start,executable_sha256,executable_dev,executable_inode,state}; state EXIT_CONFIRMED; preserved old association must match disabled archived image; native kill(pid,0) must return ESRCH, not EPERM or a reused PID
managed_contract_required_fields.transitions: ordered S0_VERIFIED_CANDIDATE, S1_MANAGED_ISOLATED, S2_OWNER_AUTHORIZED objects {state,path,evidence_sha256}; hashes transitively bind all nine ordered managed receipts

strict_parsing: Unknown/missing/incompatible fields are rejected. complete=true is not a protocol field. Native re-enumerates files, directories, nested plist identities, executable hashes, execute bits, modes, links, retained process absence, original raw plist/manifest bytes and parsed compatibility. Symlinks, hardlinks, unknown alias/bookmark files, relevant unsupported bundle layouts and undeclared matching bare executable routes fail closed.

handoff.ownership: Native verifies a separate-open contention probe before accepting inherited ownership, duplicates CLOEXEC then closes original inherited FD. Gate verifies exact ACK while retaining its FD, then closes its copy without LOCK_UN. No unlocked interval. Native retains RAII descriptor until after C closes.
handoff.revalidation: Every native event before and after callback rechecks inode, descriptor, independent contention and full session body. S6/S9/S10 additionally re-enumerate managed objects. Any recreated path/session/inode mismatch blocks.
handoff.limitation: Lease serializes supported gate/native workflows; it does not control legacy V3 binaries. Those require disabled launch routes and independent retained-process exit confirmation.

durable_native_records.launch: native-launch.json is create_new duplicate-native gate; any incomplete launch blocks replay
durable_native_records.claim: permit.json atomically renamed permit.claimed.json; consumed.json fsynced before opening C
durable_native_records.states: native-state-NNN.json immutable receipt first, then atomically replaced outcome.json, each fsynced and independently read back
durable_native_records.incomplete_write: Any pending file, missing receipt, corrupt field/hash/binding, illegal phase, or receipt ahead of outcome blocks. No state is inferred from schema.

recovery_rules.authorization_bytes: One NOFOLLOW regular-file descriptor snapshot supplies both parsed authority and SHA256. Path/inode/metadata/original bytes are rechecked before ledger consumption, before legacy consumed record, after callback and immediately before terminal publication; drift fails closed. Confirmation binds the exact original bytes and is read-only.
recovery_rules.read_only: diagnose reads no SQLite. Verified recovery acquires exact inode/session lease, independently checks all managed runtime facts, then uses a new READ_ONLY/NOFOLLOW/private-cache C with query_only and a read transaction. No sidecar recovery, checkpoint, M4, permit revival or restore.
recovery_rules.terminal_evidence: exact current DB hash before/inside read transaction, complete schema/ledger/integrity/FK, unchanged legacy rows compared with independently read exact V3 backup, runtime re-enumeration, stable object and lease. V4 also requires persisted commit lineage (phase >= 8).
recovery_rules.preservation: Original outcome/immutable state chain preserved. Recovery result binds original outcome hash, exact recovery authorization bytes and append-only attempt ledger. A consumed recovery authorization never reruns recovery; the exact same authority may only confirm an already-published terminal through read-only current-byte, lineage and lease checks.
recovery_rules.publication: Single-writer active claim plus SQLite read guard and same maintenance lease remain held through terminal publication/readback. Preterminal failure consumes the attempt and records FAILED; only a distinct fresh authority can try again. Post-publication uncertainty preserves terminal and active evidence; no success is inferred from schema or process exit.
recovery_rules.v3: FAILED_V3_CONFIRMED safe attempt terminal still blocks normal business; V4 maintenance runtime remains isolated and no old runtime is restored.
recovery_rules.v4: V4_VERIFIED handoff_authorized true only after this independent verification. Ordinary startup still requires a new compatible handoff path, never merely schema=4 or a saved success string.

frontend_loss_policy.ownership: Native alone owns Connection C and lease. No frontend command commits, rolls back or releases C. All same-origin document navigations and page-load-start (including reload) signal loss; no dedicated test URL is required.
frontend_loss_policy.pre_commit: Before the native before_commit decision fence, observed document loss aborts at a protected native callback and V3 is reported only after guarded rollback/schema proof. A vanished unobserved renderer at a barrier times out and fails closed.
frontend_loss_policy.commit_fence_and_after: The before_commit callback atomically checks loss and sets a native fence before returning to COMMIT. Loss after this fence cannot veto COMMIT or protected readback; native continues to a verified terminal or its existing UNKNOWN/GUARD_LOST error state, never an inferred V3. A postcommit diagnostic barrier auto-releases on document loss or timeout while C/lease stay native-owned.
frontend_loss_policy.business: Document replacement and terminal completion never grant ordinary business entry. Restart stays blocked until separate bound recovery handoff.
coverage: real generic same-origin replacement after initial barrier release before commit
real generic same-origin replacement after COMMIT with SQLite and lease contention probes
frontend_loss_policy.renderer_termination: NOT VERIFIED: no supported exact WebKit renderer termination hook is asserted; whole-app SIGKILL remains a different crash test. No promise of immediate renderer-loss detection outside observed navigation/page-load or a waiting barrier. Native safe continuation and ordinary-entry blocking remain the policy.

legacy_compatibility: CLI v1 historical experiments remain intact. run-integrated/recover-integrated --barrier are native-layer instrumentation only and never Q11 evidence. Real Q11 uses the isolated Tauri runtime and TS invoke boundary.
